title: One Water, Four Hours, Your Best Table

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.say: Just a tap water, thanks. I'll be here a while.

props.speaker: Leo
props.quote: Just a tap water. I'll be here *a while*.

scenes.say: The best table in the cafe, by the window. Four hours later, it's still his. And the lunch rush is walking in.
You do the math in your head. But you also remember being the one who needed a quiet table.
Next Friday, Leo's back. Two lattes and a muffin, and he brought a friend.

props.caption: The *next* Friday
props.name: Leo
props.quote: Two lattes and a muffin. Bringing *a friend*.

scenes.say: Tag an owner who has this table. Follow for more cafe life.
